business_summary: Blue Sail Medical Co.,Ltd. operates as a medical device company in China and internationally. It operates through Health Protection Division, Cardiovascular and Cerebrovascular Business Unit, and Emergency Medical Services segments. The company offers cardiovascular and cerebrovascular products comprising drug-eluting stents and balloons, and transcatheter aortic valve replacement systems; and health protection gloves consisting of disposable nitrile, PVC, latex, TPE/CPE, and polyurethane gloves for use in medical examinations, food processing, industrial labor protection, daily protection, and other applications. It also provides emergency rescue products, such as first-aid kits and disposable health protection supplies; antibody and mussel adhesive protein products; and wet wipes. In addition, the company offers cardio and neurovascular products for coronary intervention; minimally invasive surgery products, including powered endo and endoscopic staplers, open and anorectal staplers, energy sealing and dissecting instruments, access instruments, and other instruments; and disposable face masks. Further, it engages in the manufacture of rubber products, spunlace nonwoven fabric rolls, and interventional valve products for structural heart disease; sale of plastic products and sporting goods; asset and investment management; trading; research and development; business consulting; technology promotion; transfer of medical technology patent rights; textile and apparel; and electricity and heat production activities. The company sells its products under the Blue Sail brand. It serves hospitals; traders of first-aid kits and medical dressings; and distributors of automotive parts and accessories. The company was formerly known as Shandong Blue Sail Plastic & Rubber Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Blue Sail Medical Co.,Ltd. in July 2014. Blue Sail Medical Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Zibo, China.
business_summary_ko: 블루세일메디칼(주) 중국 및 국제적으로 의료기기 회사로 운영되고 있습니다. 건강 보호 부서, 심혈관 및 뇌혈관 사업부, 응급 의료 서비스 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 약물 방출 스텐트와 풍선, 경피적 대동맥 판막 교체 시스템으로 구성된 심혈관 및 뇌혈관 제품을 제공합니다. 및 일회용 니트릴, PVC, 라텍스, TPE/CPE 및 폴리우레탄 장갑으로 구성되어 건강 진단, 식품 가공, 산업 노동 보호, 일상 보호 및 기타 응용 분야에 사용되는 건강 보호 장갑입니다. 또한 구급 상자, 일회용 건강 보호 용품 등 응급 구조 용품도 제공합니다. 항체 및 홍합 접착 단백질 제품; 그리고 물티슈. 또한 이 회사는 관상동맥 중재술을 위한 심장 및 신경혈관 제품을 제공합니다. 전동 내시경 및 내시경 스테이플러, 개방형 및 항문직장 스테이플러, 에너지 밀봉 및 해부 기구, 접근 기구 및 기타 기구를 포함한 최소 침습 수술 제품; 그리고 일회용 마스크. 또한, 고무제품, 스펀레이스 부직포 제조에도 종사하고 있습니다.
